failureAnalysis.impact: Earlier fixtures were terminalized NO_MODEL where v2.4 ModelInput could not be reproduced without undocumented assumptions.

failureAnalysis.detail: Fixtures without an auditable current-model attack/defence input state were terminalized NO MODEL rather than approximated. This was concentrated on 28 Sep–1 Oct and fixtures omitted from preserved Oct 2–4 input snapshots.
High/low/total lambda gates removed several high-confidence legacy candidates from automatic publication, including known historical losing cases.

improvementCandidates: Persist exact ModelInput for every processed fixture, including NO BET and REVIEW.
Define and version a deterministic Basic historical-input builder, then rerun this same 180-day range.
Do not treat the 92.9% hit rate as a 180-day performance estimate because only 14 publishable v2.4 bets are auditable.
Persist the exact production ModelInput object for every modelled fixture, including NO BET/REVIEW outputs, so future backtests can replay all fixtures end-to-end.
Add a deterministic, versioned historical-input builder to the repository; generic recent-form data must not require an undocumented conversion into attack/defence strengths.
Use the completed sample plus a larger holdout before changing v2.4 thresholds; do not tune to the single Deportivo Pasto vs Fortaleza loss.
performanceInterpretation: The 180-day coverage run is terminal across 10,980 date/league checkpoints, but performance evidence remains 14 auditable v2.4 bets (13 wins, 1 loss) concentrated on 2-4 October. The longer range does not add independent performance evidence until historical ModelInput reconstruction is deterministic.
